how_to_apply: Visit the official KEA website, https://cetonline.karnataka.gov.in/kea/.
Read the detailed notification thoroughly, and click the link provided for the relevant cadre (General/R.P.C. or Kalyana Karnataka/K.K.) to fill the online application.
Fill in all requested personal, educational, and category details carefully - once submitted, data in the application cannot be changed or modified.
Upload the required documents and pay the application fee online.
Submit the application before 15.10.2026, and complete fee payment before 16.10.2026.
Download the Hall Ticket/Admit Card from the KEA website closer to the exam date and report to the allotted exam centre with a valid original photo ID.
important_instructions: Candidates should ensure they possess the prescribed educational qualification as on the closing date of application submission - KEA is not responsible for other eligibility-related issues arising during the application process. Candidates must be Indian citizens. A male candidate with a living spouse who marries again, or a female candidate who marries a man with a living spouse, without obtaining prior Government permission, is not eligible for appointment. Candidates must be mentally and physically healthy, fit to efficiently discharge their duties, and free from any health condition that could pose a risk to others. Persons dismissed from Central/State/other public service, or debarred from any recruitment/examination conducted by a Public Service Commission or a Recruitment Authority, are not eligible. Exam centres will be located at district centres across the state and are subject to change for administrative reasons; candidates will be informed via their admit card and the official website. Candidates cannot request a change in exam centre after allocation, and no request for postponement of any exam activity will be entertained. The recruitment committee reserves the right to cancel or reschedule the exam centre for any reason without prior notice. Candidates must download their own admit card individually - no admit card will be sent by post.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026 Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Combined Grand Total: 869 posts. These are base-cadre vacancies in the Karnataka Prisons and Reforms Services Department, recruited under the Karnataka Prisons Service (Recruitment) Rules, 2002 (and 2007, 2010 amendments), read with the Karnataka Public Employment (Hyderabad-Karnataka Region) Reservation Order, 2013 (for the K.K. cadre notification). The category-wise/post classification is published separately on the official websites.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: SSLC or currently prescribed equivalent courses are as notified in Government Order No. Sichasu 81 Sevane 2017, dated 27.02.2018. Candidates must have obtained the prescribed qualification result as on the closing date of application submission - higher qualifications will not be considered as a substitute for the specifically prescribed qualification. As per Government Notification No. Sichasu 102 Sevane 2022 dated 18.03.2025 (read with Notification No. Sichasu 43 Sevane 2020 dated 05.03.2021), candidates who studied Kannada as a first or second language subject in SSLC/equivalent, or studied through Kannada medium, are exempt from a separate Kannada Language Test. Other candidates must qualify a Kannada Language Test conducted by KEA (or a body designated by Government) within a specified time, failing which their appointment (even if otherwise selected) will not be finalised. Candidates who did not study Kannada as the first language subject in SSLC must secure a minimum of 50 out of 150 marks in the Kannada Language Test to be eligible.

rows.minimum_educational_qualification: Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification. Preference given to candidates holding a Bachelor's Degree in Sociology, Psychology, Criminology, Correctional Administration, or an equivalent qualification.
Must have passed SSLC examination or possess an equivalent qualification.
Must have passed SSLC or equivalent, AND must hold a Diploma or Certificate in Mechanical/Electrical/Carpentry/Tailoring/Textile/Weaving/Carpet-making, etc., from a Government-recognised institution.
Must have passed SSLC or equivalent, AND must hold a certificate in First Aid.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 20 years, as on the closing date of application. As per Government Order No. Sichasu 262 Sevani 2025 dated 29.01.2026, the previous upper age limit has been increased by 5 years. Ex-Servicemen: 3 years' relaxation in upper age limit, in addition to the length of military service rendered, applicable to those discharged due to reasons other than dismissal/removal for misconduct or inefficiency, with the relaxation computed on the length of "service actually rendered." To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Negative Marking: Each question has 4 options; for each wrong answer, 0.25 marks (1/4th) is deducted. In the OMR answer sheet, if a candidate marks 5 or more options for the same question, or leaves an option unshaded, 0.25 marks will be deducted per such question after a grace period. Candidates are shortlisted for PST and Endurance Test in a 1:5 ratio to notified vacancies, based on combined percentage of Competitive Exam marks and educational qualification marks, category-wise. Candidates appear for PST/Endurance Test entirely at their own risk regarding health; the recruitment committee is not responsible for any mishap during these tests. Candidates are advised to undergo their own medical fitness check and physical practice before appearing. Only candidates qualifying the Written Exam and PST/Endurance Test are eligible for the Medical Examination, conducted by a duly constituted Medical Board. Key standards include: Vision: Distant vision 6/9 (better eye) and 6/9 or 6/12 (weaker eye); Near vision 0/6 (better eye) and 0/8 (weaker eye), correctable with lenses where specified. Colour blindness, night blindness, or squint results in disqualification. Hearing: Rinne's Test, Weber's Test, and Tests for Vertigo - any deficiency found disqualifies the candidate. Other disqualifying conditions: Varicose veins, speech impediment, and musculoskeletal deformities such as Knock Knees, Flat Foot, Cubitus Valgus, and Cubitus Varus. A Chest X-Ray and any other medical tests suggested by the Medical Board will be conducted. No fee or compensation is payable to candidates for appearing in the Written Exam, PST/Endurance Test, or Medical Examination.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026 Training, Probation & Pension
content_sections.text: Training: Selected candidates must undergo basic training at institutions specified by the Director General & Inspector General of Prisons, Karnataka, and must pass all prescribed tests during training. Probation Period: 2 years from the date of appointment. Pension: The National Pension Scheme (NPS) applies, as per Government Order No. FD (SPL) 04 PEN 2005, dated 31.03.2006.

content_sections.heading: Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026 Documents Required
content_sections.text: At the time of Document Verification, candidates must carry a call letter along with any one of the following original photo-ID documents: Passport, Driving Licence, PAN Card, State/Central Government or PSU Service ID Card, Bank Passbook with photograph, Registered deed/Pattas with photograph, Caste Certificate with photograph, Ex-Servicemen's pension book/pension payment order, NREGA Job Card with photograph, Voter ID (EPIC), and Aadhaar Card.

faq.question: Q1. What is Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It refers to two related notifications by the Karnataka Examinations Authority (KEA) - for the general (Rest-of-State) cadre and the Kalyana Karnataka cadre — inviting applications for 869 base-cadre posts of Jailor, Warder, Warder cum Nursing, and Instructor Grade-II in the Karnataka Prisons and Reforms Services Department.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 869 total vacancies: 576 under the general cadre (560 Warder + 16 Instructor Grade-II) and 293 under the Kalyana Karnataka cadre (5 Jailor + 275 Warder + 5 Warder cum Nursing + 8 Instructor Grade-II).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 15.10.2026, and fee payment must be completed by 16.10.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for the Jailor post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree or equivalent qualification is required, with preference given to candidates holding a degree in Sociology, Psychology, Criminology, or Correctional Administration.

faq.question: Q5. What is the qualification required for the Warder post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed SSLC (10th standard) or an equivalent examination.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The minimum age is 20 years; the maximum age is 31 years for General Merit candidates and 33 years for SC/ST/Category-1/2A/2B/3A/3B candidates, as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q7. What is the application fee for Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹750 for General Merit and other categories, and ₹500 for SC/ST/Category-1/Ex-Servicemen candidates.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Karnataka Prisons Department Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves a 100-mark Competitive Written Examination, followed by a Physical Standard Test and Endurance Test for shortlisted candidates (1:5 ratio), and finally Document Verification and a Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q9. When is the Karnataka Prisons Department written exam scheduled?
faq.answer: The Competitive Examination is scheduled for 21.11.2026, from 3:00 PM to 4:30 PM.

faq.question: Q10. What is the pay scale for these Karnataka Prisons Department posts?
faq.answer: Jailor: ₹61,300–₹1,12,900; Warder and Instructor Grade-II: ₹37,500–₹76,100; Warder cum Nursing: ₹34,100–₹67,600.
